extract:
Within Temptation is a Dutch symphonic metal band formed in 1996 in Waddinxveen, a town in the province of South Holland. It emerged from a fertile Netherlands gothic and doom scene that also produced The Gathering and After Forever, and it has remained active for nearly three decades, becoming one of the country's most commercially successful rock exports.

The band was founded by guitarist Robert Westerholt and vocalist Sharon den Adel, who were also partners off stage. Westerholt had previously played in the band The Circle, and the pair drew on the gothic doom of the mid-1990s, a sound that paired heavy, slow riffs with atmospheric keyboards. Their debut album, Enter (1997), released on the small Dutch label DSFA Records, reflects those roots. It sets den Adel's ethereal soprano against Westerholt's death growls, with tracks like "Restless" moving at a funereal pace. The Dance EP followed in 1998.

Their second album, Mother Earth (2000), marked a turn toward a more melodic, Celtic- and fantasy-tinged symphonic style, with den Adel's voice moved firmly to the center. The single "Ice Queen" became a major hit in the Netherlands and Belgium in 2001 and broke the band to a mainstream audience. Producer Daniel Gibson began a long working relationship with the group around this period. The Silent Force (2004) expanded the sound with full orchestra and choir and yielded the singles "Stand My Ground," "Memories," and "Angels," which took the band across continental Europe. The Heart of Everything (2007), their first release through Roadrunner Records, sharpened the hooks and the guitar weight. Its lead single, "What Have You Done," featured Keith Caputo of Life of Agony and helped open the American market for them.

Within Temptation rose alongside contemporaries such as Nightwish and fellow Dutch acts After Forever and Epica, together defining the female-fronted symphonic metal wave of the 2000s. The band's lineup settled around keyboardist Martijn Spierenburg, bassist Jeroen van Veen, guitarist Ruud Jolie, and later drummer Mike Coolen. In 2008 they staged the Black Symphony concert at Rotterdam's Ahoy with the Metropole Orchestra, released on DVD. The Unforgiving (2011) was a concept album tied to a comic book series. Hydra (2014) leaned into duets with guests including Tarja Turunen, Howard Jones, Dave Pirner, and rapper Xzibit. Resist (2019) adopted a more modern, electronic-edged production and featured Jacoby Shaddix of Papa Roach and Anders Fridén of In Flames.

Critics have sometimes questioned the band's increasingly pop-oriented direction. Even so, Within Temptation has collected multiple Dutch music awards, achieved platinum certifications at home, and topped album charts in the Netherlands and elsewhere in Europe. Westerholt stepped back from touring in 2011 to focus on family life and songwriting while remaining a core creative member.

The band continues to record and tour internationally. Bleed Out (2023) carried an explicitly political edge, including songs addressing the war in Ukraine. Within Temptation's legacy lies in carrying gothic metal out of the underground and onto festival main stages and pop charts, making den Adel one of the most recognizable voices in European heavy music.
title: Within Temptation
